sql.query: INSERT INTO tbl_contract_template_versions (tenantId,templateId,versionNumber,templateName,description,bodyHtml,createdByUserId) SELECT ct.tenantId,ct.id,ct.versionNumber,ct.templateName,ct.description,ct.bodyHtml,:userId FROM tbl_contract_templates ct WHERE ct.id=:id AND ct.tenantId=:tenantId AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tbl_tenant_modules tm INNER JOIN tbl_modules m ON m.id=tm.moduleId AND m.moduleCode='CONTRACT_GENERATION' AND m.isActive=1 WHERE tm.tenantId=ct.tenantId AND tm.status IN ('ACTIVE','TRIAL')) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tbl_user_tenant_roles utr INNER JOIN tbl_roles r ON r.id=utr.roleId AND r.roleKey IN ('owner','admin') WHERE utr.userId=:roleUser AND utr.tenantId=ct.tenantId AND utr.isActive=1) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE templateName=VALUES(templateName)

UPDATE tbl_contract_templates ct SET ct.templateName=:templateName,ct.description=NULLIF(:description,''),ct.bodyHtml=:bodyHtml,ct.isActive=:isActive,ct.versionNumber=ct.versionNumber+1,ct.modifiedByUserId=:userId,ct.modifiedDate=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE ct.id=:id AND ct.tenantId=:tenantId AND NULLIF(TRIM(:templateName2),'') IS NOT NULL AND NULLIF(TRIM(:bodyHtml2),'') IS NOT NULL
DELETE FROM tbl_contract_template_clauses WHERE tenantId=:tenantId AND templateId=:templateId

INSERT INTO tbl_contract_template_clauses (tenantId,templateId,clauseId,clauseNameSnapshot,clauseHtmlSnapshot,sortOrder) SELECT c.tenantId,:templateId,c.id,c.clauseName,c.clauseHtml,FIND_IN_SET(c.id,:clauseIds) FROM tbl_contract_clauses c WHERE c.tenantId=:tenantId AND FIND_IN_SET(c.id,:clauseIds2)>0
